instruction.text: Select the flowers in the meadow.

feedback.end: Meadows are open pieces of land that are usually full of different types of grasses and flowers.

instruction.text: Select the grass in the meadow.

feedback.end: Meadows are also important for many animals. The grasses can be mowed to feed livestock, and insects thrive here too!
Plants that grow in meadows must adapt to mowing and direct sunlight. The most common meadow plant is grass because it grows back after being mowed.

atoms.a: Many types of flowers and grasses grow in meadows.

hint.text: If a habitat is biodiverse, lots of different plants, animals and insects live there.
hint.label: Biodiverse

atoms.a: Meadow plants grow best in the shade.
